name: Eye_of_the_Storm
display_fullname: Stalker Melee Staff Fighting Eye of the Storm
display_help: With a lightning fast series of spins of your staff you strike at all nearby foes dealing moderate damage with a chance of knocking foes down.  This power will build one stack of Perfection of Body if the user has two or less stacks, if the user has three stacks of Perfection of Body it will consume them and gain some benefit.  3 stacks of Perfection of Body will cause additional smashing damage and reduce damage resistance slightly for a short time. Damage: Moderate, Recharge: Long
display_short_help: PBAoE Melee, Moderate DMG(Smash), Foe Knockdown, Consumes Perfection
